title: SimpleDApp
tagline: Simple DApp - greets, changes greet, gets the balance and sends the native token.
description: Simple DApp that greets and sends native tokens. Has a function that gets the initial greeting which is "Hello World!" Another function that gets the balance of the native token from the wallet. Haven't quite figured out how to connect with other wallets aside from localhost yet.
how_its_made: used hardhat to create a react app template. this project is more so for my personal knowledge of how to interact and build web3 applications. this is my very first hackathon as well as my first web3 project. Hopefully this will challenge me to build more web3 applications or learn more about smart contracts to further develop my skillset and career path.
